title: Render collapsible shopping list header area
description: Add the reusable header view and integrate it into the shopping-list detail screen above progress and aisle sections with scene-scoped collapse persistence.
acceptance_criteria: A new header view renders extracted markdown content with the specified line handling, disclosure label, and typography.
`ShoppingListDetailView` shows the header area only when extraction returns content and places it above the progress header.
Collapse state uses the per-file `@SceneStorage` key from the spec and defaults to expanded.
